purpose: Identify representation-robust properties present in Voynich but still missing after the frozen ReM Saltzman-origin-state mechanism, with section as the primary conditioning axis.

source_provenance.section_map_source: Existing uploaded Voynich.nu-derived per-page section map used by the prior generator programme; committed unchanged as SECTION_MAP.json.

primary_conditioning.macro_average: equal weight per eligible section, not token weighted

secondary_conditioning.currier: Use RF1b page-header $L=A/B directly; do not infer Currier from section.
secondary_conditioning.hand: Use RF1b page-header $H=1..5 directly; f115r ($H=@) is split S2 for lines 1-12 and S3 thereafter, matching the prior Davis sensitivity convention.
secondary_conditioning.section_by_hand: Report cells with >=300 clean tokens and >=10 clean segments; descriptive only.
secondary_conditioning.section_by_currier: Report cells with >=300 clean tokens and >=10 clean segments; descriptive only.

frozen_mechanism.replicate_subset_rule: Fixed every-fourth subset of the existing Phase-8 20-replicate index before any residual target scoring; same P5 plan/state namespaces.

residual_scoring.baseline_scale: For each metric and synthetic representation, use the 190-document CIPHER_ONLY median and robust scale 1.4826*MAD. The same scale is used to score CIPHER_ONLY, canonical and sensitivity arms.
residual_scoring.distance: absolute z = abs(VMS metric - model median) / max(1.4826*MAD_baseline, metric floor)
residual_scoring.signed_residual: z = (VMS metric - canonical model median) / frozen baseline scale
residual_scoring.synthetic_robustness: A residual is robust across ATOMIC/LITERAL only if signs agree; magnitude is the smaller absolute z. Distance uses the worse (larger) absolute z.
residual_scoring.voynich_robustness: A section-metric residual is representation-robust only if RF_MEMBER, STA_FAMILY and AAA_CONNECTED have the same residual sign and each synthetic-robust abs(z)>=2.0.
residual_scoring.shared_residual: A metric is manuscript-shared if the representation-robust residual has the same sign in >=6 of 9 eligible sections.
residual_scoring.section_interaction: A metric is section-modulated if representation-robust residuals include opposite signs in >=2 eligible sections, or if max(abs(z))-min(abs(z))>=3.0 with max(abs(z))>=4.0 across eligible sections.
residual_scoring.mechanism_gain: For each target cell, gain = baseline absolute distance - canonical absolute distance; positive means the frozen origin-state mechanism moves toward Voynich. Robust gain is the minimum across ATOMIC/LITERAL and then across the three Voynich representations.

rules: SHARED_PLUS_SECTION_SPECIFIC if >=3 shared metrics and >=3 section-modulated metrics

prohibitions: No use of the legacy 85-metric panel
No parameter selection from Voynich residuals
No semantic glosses from residual structure
